description.describe_ch: 本課程之主要目的在協助學生了解都市更新之緣起與演變、都市更新相關理論、都市更新相關法規與政策、推動都市更新面臨之挑戰與課題及公私部門的實務操作。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of urban renewal, including its origins,  theories,  laws and policies, challenges, and practical operations in both public and private sectors.

1.上課時間若未用餐,請用完餐後再進入教室上課,以免食物味道影響上課同學
2.上課可使用筆電,平板,手機等行動裝置查詢課程相關資料或補內容,但應關閉聲音
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Leave Application Regulations

Students are required to log into the leave application system to complete their leave requests and upload supporting documents according to the reason for the leave. If a student is unable to access the system due to specific circumstances, their mentor may assist in submitting the application, provided it is done within one month from the start date of the leave.

Students who do not apply for leave or whose leave requests are not approved and fail to attend classes will be marked as absent. Personal and sick leave must be approved by the course instructor. Official leave requires approval from the Dean of Student Affairs. Leave for bereavement, pregnancy, childbirth, parental leave, miscarriage, menstrual leave, or leave for Indigenous ceremonial events will take effect automatically upon submission of the application.

If a student needs to take leave during midterm, final exams, or graduation exams, in addition to applying through the leave system, they must provide relevant supporting documents to the Registration and Curriculum Section in accordance with Article 26 of Feng Chia University Academic Regulations.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Course Reminders
	1.	Be Punctual: Attend classes on time to avoid disrupting the flow or missing key content.
	2.	Stay Focused: Pay attention during class and actively participate. Avoid using mobile phones or engaging in unrelated activities.
	3.	Engage Actively: Ask questions and join discussions to deepen your understanding of the material.
	4.	Respect Others: Show respect for the instructor’s teaching and your classmates’ contributions to maintain a positive learning environment.
	5.	Complete Assignments: Submit assignments on time to ensure steady progress and avoid last-minute stress.
	6.	Uphold Academic Integrity: Be honest in your work and exams. Avoid plagiarism and cheating.
	7.	Prepare for Exams: Review course materials regularly and prepare for exams in advance to avoid last-minute cramming.
	8.	Utilize Resources: Make full use of course materials, supplementary resources, and school facilities to support your learning.

Wishing everyone a fruitful and enjoyable learning experience!
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 在課程中應注意以下事項：完成作業時應獨立思考，避免直接抄襲他人或使用網路上的現成答案，必要時應適當引用並註明來源；參與小組討論時，要尊重他人的意見與貢獻，不得將小組的共同成果據為己有；考試期間應誠實作答，不得作弊或使用未經許可的工具；上課時需保持專注，不做與課程無關的事，如使用手機或聊天，並尊重授課教師的教學工作及其他同學的學習權利，營造良好的學習氛圍。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
General Guidelines
The following points should be noted during the course: Complete assignments independently and avoid directly copying others’ work or using ready-made answers from the internet; if necessary, appropriately cite and acknowledge the sources. During group discussions, respect others’ opinions and contributions, and do not claim the group’s collective work as your own. During exams, answer honestly, and refrain from cheating or using unauthorized tools. Stay focused during class, avoid engaging in unrelated activities such as using mobile phones or chatting, and respect the instructor’s teaching and your classmates’ right to learn. Create a positive and productive learning environment.
